subject: StratusWave x Redwood — demo availability, timezone coverage, and backup plan
body:
From: Priya Patel <priya@stratuswave.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mchen@stratuswave.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood co-sell demo — availability & goals

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the intro. We are eager to run the joint demo for StratusWave (SI + marketplace angle) next week. High-level goal: show a short 25-30 minute product walkthrough focused on (1) multi-cloud deployment examples (AWS + GCP), (2) Redwood Dedicated performance profile, and (3) marketplace listing/ops questions for AWS Marketplace.

Availability from our side (PST): Tue 11/24 between 9–11am or Thu 11/26 1–4pm. Mark (cc) will be the technical lead on our side, and we will have our Marketplace ops person on a follow-up call if needed.

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood prefers a single 30-minute slot or 45 minutes to cover marketplace ops?
- We also need an ops point-of-contact for pre-demo network/VPN checks (many of our customers want to validate NAT/firewall rules beforehand).

Attaching a draft agenda.

Best,
Priya
Principal Business Dev, StratusWave

----

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Priya Patel <priya@stratuswave.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mchen@stratuswave.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood co-sell demo — availability & goals

Thanks Priya — this looks great. We prefer to keep the live session to 30 minutes and then schedule a 20–30 minute ops deep-dive (separate follow-up) that includes marketplace listing questions. 30-minute demo keeps executives and SI leads happy; ops can be the follow-up.

Proposed times (PST) that work for us: Tue 11/24 9:30–10:00, Thu 11/26 1:30–2:00. Which of those is best for Mark?

For the pre-demo network/VPN checks, Diego will own that. He can run a quick connectivity test 48 hours before the demo. Diego — can you confirm your availability to do the check and a short checklist we should send to StratusWave?

I’ll prepare a single calendar invite for the 30-minute briefing and a separate invite for the ops deep-dive.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
calendly.com/alex-redwood

----

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Priya Patel <priya@stratuswave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Mark Chen <mchen@stratuswave.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood co-sell demo — availability & goals

Happy to own the connectivity check. I can do a 20-min window either Mon 11/24 11:00–11:20 PST (if we push) or Tue 11/24 08:00–08:20 PST (I know the team is tight that morning). I’ll draft a one-page checklist: required outbound ports, sample test curl commands to validate routing to our inference endpoints, TLS fingerprint notes, and optional VPN suggestions for air-gapped customers.

Also: for the demo itself, a couple of ops notes so the audience knows what to expect:
- We’ll show a live generation demo from our Hosted API, then a quick slide about Dedicated + region routing.
- If Mark wants to show StratusWave SI deployment, we should confirm a test dataset and short prompt set (3 prompts) — prompts should be representative and <= 512 tokens.
- Marketplace ops: we’ll cover submission checklist and billing mapping in 5 minutes — enough to explain next steps.

Dropping the checklist and a small AWS Marketplace checklist in the attachments.

— Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood
"Redwood Inference — inference that scales"

Attachments referenced: Redwood-AWS-marketplace-checklist.xlsx; Dialin_and_VPN_instructions.txt

----

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Priya Patel <priya@stratuswave.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Mark Chen <mchen@stratuswave.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood co-sell demo — availability & goals

Quick note on internal roles and backup plan:
- I will run the demo deck and tie the technical talking points to partner value (short intros + handoff to Diego for the connectivity bits).
- If Diego needs to step away, I can run the demo from our Hosted API endpoint and reference performance numbers for Dedicated (slides).
- Backup presenter: Alex (in case of timezone conflict) — Alex, can you confirm you'll take over if Diego is unavailable at showtime?

Operationally, please confirm whether StratusWave needs us to record the session and share a recording link for the Marketplace ops review. Recording is okay with our security policy but we ask partners not to share recordings externally without approval.

— Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

----

From: Priya Patel <priya@stratuswave.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mchen@stratuswave.com>, aws-marketplace@stratuswave.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood co-sell demo — availability & goals

Thanks all — Thu 11/26 1:30–2:00 PST works best for Mark and our marketplace ops lead. We’d like the ops deep-dive to be scheduled the same week (Fri 11/27 preferred) so that Marketplace ops can make a short checklist and confirm billing mapping.

Recording is fine — we’ll keep it internal at StratusWave and share only with the ops team.

Action items I will take:
- Mark will send a short test dataset (CSV) by EOD Mon 11/23.
- Marketplace ops will join the Fri deep-dive (suggest Fri 11/27 10–10:30 PST).

Please send calendar invites and the connectivity checklist to our ops alias (aws-marketplace@stratuswave.com).

Best,
Priya

----

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Priya Patel <priya@stratuswave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Mark Chen <mchen@stratuswave.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood co-sell demo — availability & goals

Great — I’ve booked the 30-minute joint demo: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 1:30–2:00 PM PST / 4:30–5:00 PM EST. Calendar invite (Zoom) sent to all including the ops alias.

I attached the final Agenda (SW_Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf) and the connectivity checklist (Dialin_and_VPN_instructions.txt). Diego — I set the pre-demo connectivity check for Tue 11/24 08:00–08:20 PST with StratusWave ops alias per your note. Please confirm or reschedule if needed.

One more note on marketplace ops: Mark, prior to the Fri deep-dive, can your AWS ops person confirm whether StratusWave prefers consolidated billing mapping or per-deal billing? That will determine the documentation we prepare.

Thanks everyone — looking forward.

— Alex

Attachments included in calendar invite: SW_Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf, Redwood-AWS-marketplace-checklist.xlsx, Dialin_and_VPN_instructions.txt
